note: Hand-written expected diagnostics, by hand from the field rules. Not produced by running FactLot. Values are synthetic. $special in an input is revived by the test into NaN or an infinity before the call. $def, $cite, $row, and $issue appear only in expected objects and are expanded by the test. A recognized citation label is caller-cited format, not publisher verification. The 400-day line is a local validation policy.

definitions.fips: Caller county_fips matched 201 (Harris County, Texas), the appraisal district. Not a taxing unit, not a tax rate, and not a parcel fact from the roll. Not a publisher check.
definitions.appraised: Caller-cited parcel.appraised_value in USD (the HCAD tot_appr_val shape). Recognized citation labels are source_id tx-harris-cad and filename Real_acct_owner.zip. A matching label is a format check only and does not verify the figure against the publisher. Not taxable value, not a sale price, and not NOI.
definitions.market: Caller-cited parcel.market_value in USD (the HCAD tot_mkt_val shape). Recognized citation labels are source_id tx-harris-cad and filename Real_acct_owner.zip. A matching label is a format check only and does not verify the figure against the publisher. Not an appraised value, not a sale price, and not NOI.
definitions.improvement: Caller-cited parcel.improvement_area_sf in square feet (the HCAD bld_ar shape). Recognized citation labels are source_id tx-harris-cad and filename Real_acct_owner.zip. A matching label is a format check only and does not verify the figure against the publisher. Not rentable area and not a sum of building-section im_sq_ft.
definitions.land: Caller-cited parcel.land_area_sf in square feet. Recognized citation labels are source_id tx-harris-cad and filename Real_acct_owner.zip. A matching label is a format check only and does not verify the figure against the publisher. The roll adapter may convert acreage when land_ar is 0; this diagnostic does not convert units and cannot tell which column was used.
definitions.tax_year: Caller-cited parcel.tax_year (the HCAD yr shape). Recognized citation labels are source_id tx-harris-cad and filename Real_acct_owner.zip. A matching label is a format check only and does not verify the figure against the publisher. Not the snapshot as-of date.

missing_tax.message: parcel.tax_year is absent, so subject.tax_year is not filled. The requested tax year is not copied in as a fact.

missing_imp.message: parcel.improvement_area_sf is absent. normalize_by improvement_area_sf is blocked. Land area is not copied into it.

missing_land.message: parcel.land_area_sf is absent. normalize_by land_area_sf is blocked. Improvement area is not copied into it.

missing_value.message: subject.value is not filled. No appraised value passed the caller-cited format checks, and market value was not relabeled as appraised.

owner.message: Owner names and mailing addresses are not read and are not returned.

unknown_input.message: The input includes a property this diagnostic does not accept. That property was ignored and was not copied into the result.

unknown_fact.message: A fact includes a property this diagnostic does not accept. That fact was not used and was not copied into the result.

houston.message: Situs city is Houston. The City of Houston does not use a conventional zoning ordinance. That is not a fact that this parcel is unzoned, and it does not describe other municipalities in Harris County. This diagnostic does not assign a zoning district.

neighborhood.message: A neighborhood code passed the caller-cited format checks. It is not an unequal-appraisal subject field, it was not checked against HCAD's neighborhood list, and the code is not repeated here.

building_class.message: A building class passed the caller-cited format checks. It is not an unequal-appraisal subject field, it is not an area, and the class text is not repeated here.

evaluation.message: evaluation_date must be a real calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. The diagnostic does not substitute today's date.

jurisdiction.message: This diagnostic is only for Harris County, Texas (FIPS 201). It does not assess other counties, does not use their published counts, and does not acquire their data.

input.message: input must be an object of caller-supplied fields.

tax_year_card.message: tax_year must be an integer from 1982 through 2100, the range calc.tx_unequal_appraisal accepts. A numeric string is not coerced.

generic.message: This diagnostic only checks the format of caller-cited Harris subject fields for calc.tx_unequal_appraisal. It does not evaluate that input, does not fetch it, and does not treat unknown as zero.

tax rate, exemption, zoning, rent, and cap rate are unsupported

issues.message: A cap rate is not inferred from roll values. Nothing is fetched.
circuit_breaker_23_231 is not set. Exemption and section 23.231 status are not accepted here. The calculator default of false is not applied, because false would mean not subject rather than unknown.
Exemption eligibility is not determined. Unknown is not "no exemption". Nothing is fetched.
NOI is not on the appraisal roll and is not inferred. Nothing is fetched.
Rent is not on the appraisal roll and is not inferred. Nothing is fetched.
No sale price is read. Roll market value is not a sale. Nothing is fetched.
No tax rate is evaluated. A rate would have to be the adopted rate of each taxing unit for this account and tax year. A county-wide rate is not assumed. Unknown is not zero. Nothing is fetched.
Taxable value after exemptions is not the appraised value and is not filled. Nothing is fetched.
Zoning is not mapped. Unknown is not unrestricted, and the lack of conventional zoning in the City of Houston is not applied to every Harris municipality. Nothing is fetched.

cases.name: year, unit, buildings-file, string value, and unrecognized label

issues.message: Each fact must be an object. That entry was skipped.
parcel.building_class must be text. A number is not improvement area and is not converted.
parcel.improvement_area_sf is cited with the buildings-file labels. Section im_sq_ft is not the account improvement area and is not copied into it. The label is not a publisher check.
parcel.appraised_value tax_year does not match the requested tax year. A different year's value is not mixed in.
parcel.land_area_sf must use unit "sf" (square feet). Acres and other units are not converted.
parcel.market_value source_id and filename are not the recognized citation labels for that predicate. A recognized label is still only caller-cited format and is not a publisher check.
